MP-ASH-Viewer 1.3.0: Active Session History for Oracle (including Standard Edition, without the Diagnostics Pack) and PostgreSQL.

**Download** `MP-ASH-Viewer-v1.3.0.zip`, unzip it and follow `README.txt` (Java 11+ with graphics, the JDBC driver in `lib/`, then `exec_ashv.sh` or `exec_ashv.bat`).

New in this version:

- **Now: OS**: the chart keeps its history while the tab is hidden. With the automatic refresh on, only `v$osstat` is read in the background (one small query per interval), so the chart already has the points since the connection when the tab is opened. The chart shows the last hour, whatever the refresh interval.

All changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mpontes-stack/MP-ASH-Viewer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
